<!-- pr-reviewer: f6c7f605f981f3f85b974ab353231bd5bc60d083 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers. This PR is stacked on #2254: merge #2254 first, and retarget this PR to `main` before #2254 merges.

### What looks good
- The fix agrees with the cause in the #2246 measurement. `refresh_preview` makes the triangles one time, with the region, under the same key (draft parameters, draft area, geometry source, document version). The region and its fill cannot go stale apart.
- `world::collect_parts` only reads the stored triangles now. No triangulation occurs on a still frame.
- The behavior does not change: `fill_of` gives `None` for a failed or empty triangulation, as the old scene code did. `preview_fill` still prefers `footprint` to `region`.
- `fill_of` has no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!`. `Fill` is an `Arc`, so a preview clone is cheap.
- Display only. The PR does not change cut geometry, posted G-code, goldens, stock simulation or gouge checks. This is not a safety-tier change.
- The new test `area_preview_fill_is_made_once_per_draft` pins all parts of the key: still frames (`Arc::ptr_eq`), a draft edit, a return to the first draft, an applied `EditOperationBoundary` and its `Undo`.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/2246-area-preview-fill.md` is there. The body has `Fixes #2246` and a `Changelog:` line. The PR does not edit `CHANGELOG.md`, snapshot PNGs or process files.

### Results (local, PR head trial-merged with `main` 768834bc7, debug)
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | build OK |
| `camcraft-ui` lib, `frame_cost_probe` (2 tests) | 2 passed |
| `camcraft-ui` lib, all | 968 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored |
| `camcraft-ui --test boundary_picks` | 6 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --test boundary` | 3 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The trial merge with `main` had no conflicts.

### Mutations (local, then reverted)
1. The key check in `refresh_preview` never matches, so the preview is made again on each frame. Result: RED. `still_frames_on_fig8_name_their_costs` fails ("c: no preview triangulation", left 6, right 0). `area_preview_fill_is_made_once_per_draft` fails ("still frames keep the same triangles").
2. A key change keeps the old fill (a stale cache). Result: RED. `area_preview_fill_is_made_once_per_draft` fails ("Inside fills another area than Outside").

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
- Merge order: #2254, then this PR. Retarget this PR to `main` first (AGENTS.md "Overlapping issues stack"). If you do not, `--delete-branch` on #2254 closes this PR.
- No screenshots are necessary. The change is not visible: the area preview looks the same, and only the frame time changes.
- `crates/ui/src/boundary_draft.rs` is 419 lines. It was over 400 lines before this PR, and the PR adds 4 lines.
- The still frame in state c is 14.8 ms (release). This is more than the 10 ms target of #2246. The body gives the remaining costs to #2247, #2250 and #2248. That is correct for the scope of this PR.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: f6c7f605f981f3f85b974ab353231bd5bc60d083 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge, after #2254 (the base) merges and this PR is retargeted to main.**

Reviewed as a stacked PR: its own diff against `issue/2238-frame-cost-rule`.

**What looks good**
- The fill is made once in `refresh_preview` (`crates/ui/src/boundary_draft.rs`, last lines), under the existing preview key (draft params, draft area, geometry source, document version). Region and fill come from one key, so they cannot go stale apart. No stale-picture path found.
- `world::collect` only reads the stored triangles. The `Arc<[..]>` keeps a clone of the preview cheap.
- Same filter as before: refused or empty gives no fill.
- Pinned by `frame_cost_probe::area_preview_fill_is_made_once_per_draft` (`Arc::ptr_eq` on still frames, remake on draft change, remake on Apply and Undo) and by the changed `still_frames_on_fig8_name_their_costs` (0 triangulations in a still frame).
- The decision file `docs/decisions/2246-area-preview-fill.md` is present. No snapshot, golden or project-format change. No new dependency.

**Results** (locally, on the PR head, not merged with main - see the note below)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 969 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. Trial merge with current `origin/main` (2360d879c) conflicts in `crates/ui/src/state.rs` (`drain_actions`, around line 3018). The conflict comes from the parent #2254 (its `commands/mcp+chat` spans against main's `ai_chat.poll(&mut self.history)` change), not from this PR's lines. #2254 is not on main yet. It needs the refresh at merge time, so I built the head as it is. The `conflicts` label is not set because this PR merges cleanly with its own base.
2. Merge order: retarget this PR to `main` first, then merge #2254, as the PR body says.
3. Not exercised here: the real window and GPU upload.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
